subject: Insurance
title: Genetic Testing and Life Insurance
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Genetic Testing and Life Insurance.

hook.text: A simple DNA test can reveal your risk for cancer, Alzheimer's, or heart disease.

buildup.text: Life insurance depends on risk assessment. Genetic data is the most precise predictor of future health conditions.

discovery.text: GINA, a US law, bans genetic discrimination in health insurance.

twist.text: People who know they carry high-risk genes may buy extra life insurance while hiding test results.

climax.text: Genetic testing forces insurance to choose: use all data for accurate pricing.

punchline.text: DNA reveals your future health risks. Who gets to see your results?

quiz.question: What law bans genetic discrimination in US health insurance?
